decision_clause: Ruled out: "pin every prose field by literal digest" — freezing the full text duplicates the contract into the validator and makes any editorial fix a false failure, so only fields the contract derives or fixes numerically are pinned. Scope: docs/tickets/E0-A/E0A-001-freeze-m01-m20-metric-registry.md, packages/schema/src/metric-registry.ts, packages/schema/test/metric-registry.test.ts, scripts/validate-planning.mjs, specs/metrics.v0.json, tests/planning/workspace-skeleton.test.mjs; lifecycle active.
label: COMPLIANT
observable_behavior: diff.patch is zero bytes: the finished tree is byte-identical to the base tree, so no new checking behavior was introduced anywhere in the recorded scope. In the tree as it stands, the registry validator (packages/schema/src/metric-registry.ts) treats free-text fields — label, question, observation_type, eligible_opportunity, partial_credit_rule, not_observed_rule, invalid_rule, normalization, gaming_guard — as presence-only: they appear solely in the REQUIRED_FIELDS list used by the MISSING_FIELD / DEAD_FIELD loop (lines 62-66, 189-194), and their string values are never compared against any stored literal, table, or hash. Every field whose value is compared is one the contract derives or fixes numerically or enumerably: version tag (line 196), cap===1 / floor===0 (199-200), factor from the F1-F6 index ranges (211), treatment from the M19/M15-M17 rule (214), aggregation from the M19-vs-rest rule (217-219), minimum_opportunities 1-or-2 (221-224), evidence_precedence against the five-entry frozen order (225-230), confidence against the frozen numeric table (231-237), per_opportunity_formula reconstructed from the metric's own numerator/denominator or the frozen precision/recall/F1 string (239-255), M11 denominator===6 (247), and consumer_routes rebuilt by ROUTES_OF (256-262). No SHA/digest of any metric text exists: createHash appears only in scripts/validate-planning.mjs:780 (hashing whole governance gate-artifact files) and tests/planning/workspace-skeleton.test.mjs:272 (constructing that same gate fixture), neither of which touches a metric-registry prose field.
rationale: The ruled-out approach is a validator that freezes the registry's free-text prose by literal digest or literal full text, so an editorial rewording fails the check. The finished tree does not do that anywhere in the recorded scope — and cannot have introduced it, since diff.patch is empty and the tree is unchanged from the base. Reading the tree directly confirms the surviving shape is the one the decision endorses rather than the one it rejected: prose fields are checked only for presence and for not being dead, while value-pinning is confined to fields the contract derives (formula from numerator/denominator, routes from factor/treatment) or fixes numerically/enumerably (cap, floor, confidence table, precedence order, minimum opportunities, M11 denominator). Editing a metric's label or question text would not trip the validator; editing its cap or its consumer routes would. The two digest computations in the tree hash governance gate artifacts as whole files, an unrelated pre-existing mechanism, not metric prose fields. Separately, and outside the question I am asked: the task's stated deliverable is absent — MetricDefinition (packages/schema/src/metric-registry.ts:26-51) still does not declare observation_key even though the validator reads metric.observation_key at lines 240, 250, 350-351 and 367 and REQUIRED_FIELDS lists it, and no compile-checked public consumer exists. That is a completion gap, not a decision violation, and it does not change the label.
